verdict.rationale: Cursor's docs explicitly describe debugging workflows — 'Reproduce issues, narrow the root cause, and verify the fix' and 'Inspect diffs, run checks, and catch problems before you merge' — which align with natural-language-driven troubleshooting via its agent chat interface. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on evidence validating debugging accuracy in practice, and more detail on how natural-language queries map to root-cause analysis beyond marketing copy.
